comparison.objective: Set and retain a blind’s rail height and louver angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Lift a rail and actuate a separate tilt lever; no concentric driver-and-jam-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Rail and louvers hold at specified positions after release, not a locked stop surviving functional cycles.
comparison.reason: It tests independent blind adjustments rather than preserving a screw setting while locking it against nut reaction.
